description.narrative: The objective of the Emission Reductions Program (ER Program) is to make payments to the Program Entity for measuredcomma reported and verified Emission Reductions (ERs) related to reduced deforestation and forest degradationcomma the enhancement of forest carbon stocks (REDD+) at the national level in Costa Ricacomma and distribution of ER payments in accordance with agreed Benefit Sharing Plan (BSP).
